./build.purpose: `discoverCapabilityFiles`/`parseCapabilityFile`/`linkCapabilityFiles`/`evaluateLiteral` (discovery), `buildInventory` (the `CapabilityInventory` model), the other canonical models (`buildLifecycleModel`/`buildDependencyModel`/`buildOwnershipModel`/`buildFindingModel`/`buildChangeModel`/`buildEvidenceModel`), the evidence cache (`getEvidenceModel`/`computeSourceFingerprint`), the report generators (`generateManifest`/`generateDocumentation`/`generateUsage`/`generateFlow`), and the orchestrator (`generateDataArtifacts`/`checkArtifacts`); and, Experimental (ADR 0070–0075), the field-level flow pass (`flowEvidence`, `flowSinks`, `flowSummaries`/`FlowSummary` to declare what a package call does, `scanFlow`) with the same projections `./evidence` exports (including `buildSarifLog`, `buildCycloneDxBom`, `analyzeRedundantTransforms`)

./node.purpose: `nodeBuildFileSystem` — the ready-made `BuildFileSystem` adapter a build script hands to `./build`

./evidence.purpose: `defineEvidenceProjection` — the schema-object projection definer with a read-only membrane and per-output-field provenance. Imports `EvidenceModel` with `import type` only, so it never pulls in `node:fs` or the TypeScript compiler API; `./build` re-exports it for backward compatibility. Experimental additions (ADR 0070–0075), every one a pure function of the one Evidence Model: `traceFlow`/`traceFlowBetween`/`filterFlow`/`diffFlow`/`observedFlow`, `buildFlowGraphView`, `renderFlowText`/`renderFlowDot`/`renderFlowMermaid`, `buildProvDocument`, `buildOscalAssessmentResults`, `observationsToOtlp`/`observationsFromOtlp`, `buildCycloneDxBom`/`renderFlowCycloneDx` (CycloneDX 1.6), `analyzeLeastData`, `analyzeRedundantTransforms`/`redundantTransformFindings` (ADR 0075), `evaluateEvidenceRules`/`parseEvidenceRules`.

./observe.purpose: `observeBoundary`, `observeValue`, `observeSink`, `instrumentBoundary`, `observeResponse`, `createMemorySink` — record which field NAMES crossed which boundary (auto-walking a value, wrapping a method, cloning a response body), into a sink you supply; never values, never I/O of its own, no clock unless you pass one; what the walker leaves out is reported through `onSkip`/`sink.skip`, not hidden (ADR 0072).

./schema.purpose: The published JSON Schema for `data-cap --json` output (`data-cap-report.schema.json`), plus the model schemas under `./schema/*`

dependencies.@typescript/typescript6: The TypeScript 6 compiler the build entry parses sources with when the project's own TypeScript is 7 or missing. Bundled inside the tarball, about 5 MB packed and 24 MB unpacked; no runtime entry can reach it (`compiler-isolation`).
dependencies.typescript: The project's own compiler, used by the build entry instead of `@typescript/typescript6` when it is version 5 or 6.
dependencies.eslint: Only for `data-cap/eslint-plugin`, which runs inside the project's own ESLint.
dependencies.@typescript-eslint/utils: Only for `data-cap/eslint-plugin`; projects linting TypeScript already have it through `typescript-eslint`.

standards.limits: A violation's `codeFlow` is the path the static scan found; the scan is syntactic and does not follow every construct (see the Guide's data-flow limits).
